import socket,sys,time
import arena
b=arena.load_board()
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM); s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock'); f=s.makefile('rw')
def send(c): f.write(c+'\n'); f.flush()
send('uci')
while True:
 l=f.readline().strip()
 print(l) if len(sys.argv)>3 else None
 if l=='uciok': break
send('setoption name Threads value 4'); send('setoption name Hash value 256')
send('setoption name MultiPV value '+(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else '3'))
send('isready')
while f.readline().strip()!='readyok': pass
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
send('go movetime '+str(int(float(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 30)*1000)))
lines={}
while True:
 l=f.readline().strip()
 if l.startswith('info depth') and ' pv ' in l:
  a=l.split(); lines[int(a[a.index('multipv')+1])]=l
 if l.startswith('bestmove'):
  for k in sorted(lines): print(lines[k])
  print(l); break
send('quit')

 print(subprocess.check_output(['python3','arena.py','move',move],text=True),flush=True)
